title: GasNetSim_4Qgis: An Open-Source 3D Geospatial Digital Twin Framework for Regional Gas Transmission and Hydrogen Blending
description: A high-fidelity geospatial and thermo-fluid-dynamic digital twin plugin for QGIS coupling GIS vector processing with the GasNetSim matrix solver. Supports 3D geodesic elevation modeling (DEM), explicit Chen (1979) friction transitions, full GERG-2008 real-gas thermodynamics (ISO 20765-2), and multicore parallel simulation of large-scale hydrogen blending roadmaps. Version 0.9.0 adds a built-in bilingual user Guide (IT/EN) documenting every interface control and the underlying physics. The plugin version is independent of that of the GasNetSim engine: the engine version and commit actually used are recorded alongside every result set.
